name: The Madrid EDITION
insider_take: A sophisticated urban sanctuary where Madrid's royal heritage meets cutting-edge design in the heart of the cultural district.
whats_special: The Madrid EDITION occupies a meticulously restored 19th-century building steps from the Prado Museum and Retiro Park. This boutique luxury property features Ian Schrager's signature design philosophy, blending historic Spanish architecture with contemporary flair. The rooftop terrace offers stunning views of Madrid's skyline, while the ground-floor restaurant showcases innovative Spanish cuisine.
pro_tip: Book the rooftop bar for sunset cocktails - it's one of Madrid's best-kept secrets with panoramic views over the Golden Triangle of Art, and locals don't know about the hotel entrance through the discrete side street.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you within a 3-minute walk of the world-famous Prado Museum and 5 minutes from Retiro Park's Crystal Palace. The nearby Barrio de las Letras (Literary Quarter) offers authentic tapas bars where Hemingway once wrote, and the Thursday evening rooftop DJ sessions are legendary among Madrid's creative crowd.
pros: Prime central Madrid location near major attractions
Contemporary luxury design with modern amenities
Exceptional dining and rooftop bar experiences
Part of prestigious Marriott STARS Program with exclusive benefits
cons: Modern minimalist style may not suit traditional preferences
